title: The linden at the intersection
summary: This east-facing photograph shows a mature linden beside the right curb. The city measured a 53 cm trunk there. The original game placed the treetop in the cross street and discarded it. The canopy-height raster shows continuous foliage back to the mapped trunk.
measurement: The mean error in the left edge of the right-hand crown fell from 36 to 11 percentage points of frame width across six rows. In the lower 260 pixels, both 960 × 720 renders are identical. The game still underestimates the reach of the foliage toward the middle of the road.

images.caption: Lincoln, Nebraska, August 19, 2025. Public street photograph, previous game canopy, and the same frame with the municipal linden restored.
